title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.9 (Peaked September 29, 2026 at 14:47 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 290 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

All quiet on the Sunwatch front. 👀🤍

A few small sunspot groups and a prominent bright active region are visible today, with no clear large outward coronal structure.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
